newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Krasnoyarsk Q1 aluminium output 200,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Russian Krasnoyarsk Q1 aluminium output 200,000 T.

text.p: Primary aluminium output at Russia's giant Krasnoyarsk smelter was around 200,000 tonnes in the first quarter, with about 70 percent of production exported, a senior company official told Reuters on Wednesday.

The official, speaking from the smelter's Siberian headquarters in Krasnoyarsk, also said the plant had wage arrears of two months and total debts equal to at least $300 million, but he said there was no labour unrest.
The smelter, also known as KrAZ, produced 777,000 tonnes of primary aluminium in 1996, up 2.8 percent on 1995's level.
Russia was the world's largest exporter of primary aluminium last year, sending 2.44 million tonnes to world markets from total 1996 output of 2.87 million tonnes.
